Description.name: Epic Bona-Petite
Description.description: If Galvana, Celestial of Electricity could be the said to be the 'godmother' of the Wublins (and we think that's an appropriate term), then the godfather would be Vhamp, Celestial of Mech. The tinkerer's influence can be felt in the chimeral and eclectic nature of the Wubbox's creations, and the Mech-anically-minded Epic Bona and Petite are the true materializations of that influence.
